name.es: Cuestionario de cambio Climático 2023 de CDP
name.pt_br: Questionário de Mudanças Climáticas do CDP de 2023

information.en:
• This module requests information about your organization’s disclosure to CDP and will help data users to interpret your responses in the context of your business operations, timeframe and reporting boundary. 
  • The information provided here should apply consistently to your responses throughout the questionnaire and be complete and accurate as it may determine response options presented in subsequent modules. 
  • For this reason, you should respond to every question in this module and save your response before accessing the rest of the questionnaire.
information.es:
• El módulo solicita información acerca del reporte de su organización a CDP y ayudará a los usuarios de los datos a interpretar sus respuestas en el contexto de sus operaciones comerciales, cronogramas y alcance de la divulgación de información. 
  • La información aquí proporcionada debe aplicarse sistemáticamente a sus respuestas en todo el cuestionario y debe ser completa y precisa ya que puede determinar opciones de respuesta que figuren en módulos posteriores. 
  • Por ende, debe responder cada pregunta de este módulo y guardar su respuesta antes de continuar con el resto del cuestionario.
information.ja:
• 本モジュールでは、貴社のCDPへの開示に関する情報をお答えいただきます。これによりデータ利用者は、貴社の回答を、事業運営、時間的枠組み、報告バウンダリといった背景事情にもとづいて解釈することができます。 
  • ここで回答いただいた内容は、質問書全体を通じて一貫して適用されるものです。後続のモジュールで表示される回答選択肢にも影響しますので、回答漏れなく正確にお答えください。 
  • またこの理由により、本モジュールでは全質問にお答えいただき、残りの質問書への回答を続ける前に、必ず保存を行ってください。
information.pt_br:
• Este módulo pede informações sobre a divulgação da sua organização para o CDP e ajuda os usuários dos dados a interpretar as suas respostas no contexto das suas operações comerciais, horizonte temporal e dos seus limites de divulgação. 
  • As informações fornecidas aqui devem se aplicar às suas respostas de modo consistente ao longo de todo o questionário e ser completas e precisas, pois podem determinar as opções de resposta apresentadas nos módulos subsequentes. 
  • Por esta razão, é necessário responder a todas as questões deste módulo e salvar suas respostas antes de acessar o restante do questionário.
information.zh_chs:
• 此模块要求贵公司提供CDP披露情况的信息，这将会帮助CDP的数据用户结合贵公司的运营、时间段和填报界限更好地理解贵公司的回复。 
  • 这里提供的信息可能会决定后续模块中出现的回复选项，因而需要保证在整份问卷回复的一致性，必须完整且精确。 
  • 因此，您应对该模块的所有问题逐一进行回复，并在后续问卷的填写前将回复保存。

information.en:
•  Board-level oversight of climate-related issues is considered best practice and provides an indication of the importance of climate-related issues to the organization. 
  • This module is intended to capture the governance structure of your company with regard to climate change, and provides data users with an understanding of the organization's approach to climate-related issues at the board level and management level.
information.es:
•  La supervisión a nivel de la Junta Directiva sobre los asuntos relacionados con el clima se considera una de las mejores prácticas y brinda una idea de la importancia que tienen los asuntos relacionados con el clima para la organización. 
  • El objetivo de este módulo es captar la estructura de gobernanza de su empresa en relación con el cambio climático, y explicar a los usuarios de los datos el enfoque de la organización sobre los asuntos relacionados con el clima a nivel de la junta y de la gerencia.
information.ja:
•  気候関連問題を取締役会レベルで監督することはベストプラクティスであり、それはまた気候関連問題が組織に対して重要であることを示しています。 
  • 本モジュールの目的は、気候変動に関する貴社のガバナンス構造を明らかにすることにあります。これにより利用者は、貴社の気候関連問題に対する取締役会レベルおよび経営レベルのアプローチを理解することができます。
information.pt_br:
•  A supervisão no nível do Conselho diretor de questões relacionadas ao clima é considerada uma boa prática e fornece indicações sobre a importância das questões climáticas para a organização. 
  • Este módulo tem como intenção captar a estrutura de governança da sua empresa com relação às mudanças climáticas e fornecer aos usuários dos dados uma compreensão do modo como a organização aborda as questões relacionadas ao clima nos níveis do conselho e da gestão.
information.zh_chs:
•  气候相关议题的董事会层级监督被认为是最佳实践，并说明各气候相关议题对组织的重要性。 
  • 该模块旨在了解贵公司的气候变化治理结构，并让数据使用者了解公司在董事会层级和管理层层级处理气候相关议题的方法。

value.text: The CEO meets with the sustainability manager four times per year to discuss climate related developments and review the company's policies and operations relevant to sustainability matters to assure they are adapted to the latest developments. During those meetings, progress towards the company's emissions reduction goals and targets are monitored and evaluated. If any major capital expenditures or if business plans that are expected to have an environmental impact are being considered, the sustainability manager is involved to advise the board on any relevant climate related aspects. When performance objectives are being set, climate related aspects, such as CO2 emissions are considered as a performance indicator.

value.text: The Chief Executive Officer is head of the sustainability department and is responsible for ensuring that the company's sustainability vision is being implemented in all departments and that this vision is being communicated to all stakeholders.

The Sustainability manager reports directly to the executive board and is responsible for formulating policies to ensure sustainability and setting sustainability goals and targets. The sustainability manager is also responsible for creation and follow up of emission and resource consumption metrics, life cycle assessment of products, increasing reliance on renewable energy and involvement in the circular economy. Additionally, raising employee awareness about sustainability, preparing annual sustainability reports and carbon disclosure reporting, as well as assuring compliance with local and international sustainability standards all belong to the tasks of the sustainability manager.

information.en:
• Evaluating exposure to climate-related risks and opportunities over a range of time horizons allows for a strategy for the transition to a net-zero carbon economy recognized in the Paris Agreement and UN SDGs. This module focuses on processes for identifying, assessing, and responding to climate-related issues as well as on the climate-related risks and opportunities identified by your organization. This information helps investors to assess the potential impacts to valuations and the adequacy of the company’s risk response.    
  •  Many of the challenges you face when reporting on climate-related issues are common to other aspects of corporate reporting, requiring you to provide statements about your prospective condition. Some organizations, particularly accounting firms and their governing bodies, have published guidance about how to prepare statements that contain forward-looking information. 
  • You may wish to consult with your financial, legal, and/or compliance departments for advice on your company’s general approach to the provision of forward-looking statements and information concerning risks. 
  • Note that the questions relate to “inherent” risk and not the “residual” risk that remains after management measures have been taken into account. 
  • Note for financial services sector companies:  The TCFD recommendations highlight the importance of the financial sector considering the impacts of climate-related issues in the context of their financing activities. When evaluating exposure to climate-related risks and opportunities, financial services sector companies should primarily consider the impact on their lending, financial intermediary, investing and/or insurance underwriting activities, in addition to operational activities.
information.es:
• Evaluar la exposición a los riesgos y las oportunidades relacionados con el clima en una variedad de horizontes temporales permite establecer una estrategia para la transición hacia una economía con cero emisiones netas de carbono reconocida en el Acuerdo de París y los Objetivos de Desarrollo Sostenible (SDG, por sus siglas en inglés) de la ONU. Este módulo se centra en los procesos para identificar, evaluar y responder a los asuntos relacionados con el clima, así como en los riesgos y oportunidades relacionados con el clima que su organización identifique. Esta información ayuda a los inversionistas a evaluar los impactos potenciales de las valoraciones y si las respuestas de la empresa a los riesgos son adecuadas.    
  •  Muchos de los desafíos que enfrenta al divulgar información sobre asuntos relacionados con el clima también se presentan en otros aspectos de la divulgación corporativa, lo cual requiere que deba presentar declaraciones sobre su condición futura. Algunas organizaciones, especialmente las empresas de contabilidad y sus órganos de gobierno, han publicado una orientación sobre cómo preparar declaraciones que contengan información con miras al futuro. 
  • Puede consultar a los departamentos financiero, legal y/o de cumplimiento normativo para recibir asesoramiento sobre el enfoque general de su empresa para proporcionar declaraciones con miras al futuro e información sobre riesgos. 
  • Cabe mencionar que las preguntas se relacionan con el riesgo “inherente” y no con el riesgo “residual” que permanece una vez que se han tomado medidas de gestión. 
  • Nota para las empresas del sector de servicios financieros:  Las recomendaciones del TCFD destacan la importancia de que el sector financiero considere los impactos de los asuntos relacionados con el clima en el contexto de sus actividades financieras. Al evaluar la exposición a riesgos y oportunidades relacionados con el clima, las empresas del sector de servicios financieros deben considerar principalmente el impacto de sus actividades de préstamo, intermediación financiera, inversión y/o emisión de seguros, además de las actividades operativas.
information.ja:
• 気候関連リスクおよび機会への対峙についてさまざまな時間軸での評価を行うことで、パリ協定や国連SDGs(持続可能な開発目標)が示す炭素ネットゼロ経済への移行についての戦略の策定が可能となります。このモジュールでは、気候関連課題の特定、評価、管理のプロセスと、貴社が特定した気候関連リスクおよび機会に重点を置きます。この情報は、投資家が企業のリスク対応についての潜在的評価と妥当性を評価するのに役立ちます。   
  •  気候関連課題の報告の際に直面する課題の多くは、今後の自社の状態を予測し表明することを要求しているという点で、他の側面における企業報告における課題と共通しています。将来展望を含む表明をどのように作成すべきかについては、会計事務所や管轄当局などの組織がガイダンスを発行しています。 
  • 貴社における将来展望の表明やリスクに関わる情報の提供についての一般的手法に関する助言を求めて、財務、法務、および/またはコンプライアンス部門に相談してもよいでしょう。 
  • なおこの質問が対象とするのは「内在する」リスクであり、管理対策を考慮した後に残る「残留」リスクではない点にご注意ください。 
  • 金融サービスセクター向け注記:  TCFD提言では、資金調達活動による気候関連課題への影響を考慮している金融セクターの重要性に注目しています。気候関連リスクおよび機会へのエクスポージャーを評価する際、金融サービスセクター企業は自社事業活動に加えて、融資、金融仲介、投資、および/または保険引受への影響を主に考慮する必要があります。
information.pt_br:
• Avaliar a exposição aos riscos e oportunidades climáticos em uma série de horizontes temporais permite estabelecer uma estratégia de transição para uma economia de zero carbono líquido reconhecida pelo Acordo de Paris e pelos ODSs da ONU. Este módulo tem como foco os processos de identificação, avaliação e resposta aos problemas climáticos, assim como os riscos e oportunidades climáticos identificados pela organização. Estas informações ajudam os investidores a avaliarem os potenciais impactos nas avaliações e a adequação da resposta da empresa aos riscos.    
  •  Muitos dos desafios enfrentados ao divulgar problemas climáticos se aplicam também a outros aspectos do reporte corporativo, exigindo que se forneçam demonstrações sobre suas prováveis condições futuras. Algumas organizações, em particular empresas de contabilidade e respectivas entidades reguladoras, publicaram orientações sobre como preparar demonstrações que contenham informações prospectivas. 
  • Pode ser interessante consultar os departamentos financeiro, jurídico e/ou de conformidade para obter orientações sobre a abordagem geral da empresa para o fornecimento de demonstrações futuras e informações relativas aos riscos. 
  • Observe que as perguntas se relacionam aos riscos “inerentes” e não aos riscos “residuais”, que persistem após serem levadas em conta medidas de gestão. 
  • Nota para empresas do setor de serviços financeiros:  As recomendações da TCFD destacam a importância de o setor financeiro levar em conta os impactos das questões climáticas no contexto de suas atividades financeiras. Ao avaliar a exposição a riscos e oportunidades climáticos, as empresas do setor de serviços financeiros devem primeiramente considerar o impacto para suas atividades de empréstimo, intermediação financeira, investimentos e/ou subscrição de seguros, além das atividades operacionais.
information.zh_chs:
• 评估在一定时间范围内的与气候相关的风险和机遇敞口有助于制定巴黎协定和联合国可持续发展目标认可的向零碳经济转型的策略。该模块重点关注气候相关议题的识别、评估和应对流程，以及贵公司发现的气候相关风险和机遇。该信息能够帮助投资者估算其对价值的潜在影响，以及公司风险应对的充分性。   
  •  报告气候相关议题时遇到的许多挑战也常见于公司其他方面的报告，都要求您提供有关贵公司未来情况的陈述。一些公司，特别是会计师事务所及其管理机构，已经发布了关于如何准备包含前瞻性信息陈述的指南。 
  • 您可以咨询您的财务、法律和/或合规部门，从而为贵公司提供前瞻性陈述和风险相关信息的一般方法建议。 
  • 请注意，问题与“固有”风险有关，而与在考虑管理措施后依然存在的“剩余”风险无关。 
  • 金融服务业公司的说明： TCFD的建议强调了金融行业必须结合自身金融活动来考虑气候相关问题的影响。在评估与气候相关的风险和机会时，金融服务部门的公司除了业务活动之外，还应主要考虑对其贷款、金融中介、投资和/或保险承保活动的影响。

value.html: ACIP's sustainability department identifies and analyses any climate related risks that could affect the company and evaluates their impact on the ability to achieve operational, financial and strategic objectives. The sustainability department works closely with the asset & cost management department as well as the planning and sales departments to determine the financial and strategic impact of any related climate risks, and also works with the production management to estimate operational impacts. Any risk that has an impact over EGP 100,000 is considered substantive. Methods to mitigate those risks are identified where possible, before being reported and discussed with the executive board to take necessary action.

value.text: ACIP's sustainability department follows and monitors climate change closely, taking into consideration the current global climate situation and its impact on the environment as well as forecasted future developments based on scientific research and reports. The sustainability department updates the board on the identified risks and their impact on the company, and suggests possible solutions to respond to those risks. Measures taken to reduce ACIP's carbon footprint that are expected to have a positive financial impact are considered as climate related opportunities.

value.text: Located in the governorate of Alexandria in Egypt, chronic physical climate related hazards are considered as Alexandria is a coastal city where rising sea level must be taken into consideration. The rising sea level is not expected to affect the governorate anytime soon, especially because the Egyptian government spends significantly on protecting the northern Egyptian coast from the rising sea level. Additionally, ACIP's factory is located in an area of high altitude that is less likely to be affected by the rising sea level. However, if the sea level rises and causes damage to roads and ports, it may have a strategic and financial impact on the long term.

value.text: The incorporation of recycled raw materials such as r-PET not only reduces plastic waste ending up in the environment, but also reduces the carbon footprint of the product throughout the value chain, as the processing of r-PET consumes less energy and therefore less emissions by eliminating the extraction and separation phases of crude oil as well as the polymerization process from the lifecycle of the product. ACIP has set among its targets the incorporation of r-PET as a raw material to meet global sustainability goals, the goals of our clients and to fulfill our corporate social responsibility. However, the cost of r-PET is significantly high compared to virgin PET and therefore imposes a financial risk to our company taking into consideration that PET is our main raw material.

ACIP is located in the city of Alexandria in Egypt. Most of Alexandria sits on low lying land making large areas of the city subject to submerge under the rising sea level within the current century. The rise in sea level may vary widely depending on the rate of global warming.
A rise in sea level would submerge the port of Alexandria which is the largest port in Egypt, eliminating one of our main logistic advantages of being located close to a major export hub. If sea level rises and submerges large areas of Alexandria including highways and roads, our manufacturing processes and sales would be largely affected as it would impede the transportation of raw materials and finished goods. Finally, if sea level increases much enough to submerge the fourth industrial zone in Borg El Arab, where our factory is located, it would cause total destruction to all assets and machinery and impair our production process.

ACIP's machinery can be classified into hydraulic and all-electric machinery. Hydraulic machines are much less energy efficient than all electric machinery and thus have a higher carbon footprint. It is planned to systematically replace the hydraulic machinery with all-electric machinery over the next 20 years, which will require an additional capital expenditure.

description.ja: 財務上の影響額の説明

value.text: Based on the average purchasing price of virgin PET, the price of r-PET in the Egyptian market, and ACIP's production during 2021, and the assumption of incorporation of r-PET as 25% of our raw material, we expect the measure to increase our expenses by EGP 1,184,951 annually. On average, the price of r-PET is 36% higher than that of virgin PET.

We expect the financial impact to be EGP 147,146 per annum if the port of Alexandria gets submerged due to additional transportation costs to distant alternatives. The cost of transporting our export containers to the nearest alternative port in Suez would cost ACIP EGP 147,146 more than it would cost to transport the containers to the nearby port of Alexandria, resembling a 200% increase in transportation costs. Based on the worst case scenario if the sea level rises high enough to submerge the factory causing complete destruction of assets, ACIP's losses would be estimated at EGP 97,574,200 based on its current book value.
The purchase of 4 modern all electric machines to replace the hydraulic ones would cost ACIP EGP 7,516,800.

value.text: Increasing recycled content in packaging is one of the common goals among most of our clients and the global market. We expect it to be obligatory within the upcoming several years. Despite having a financial impact on ACIP, we think that it is an efficient measure to reduce ocean plastic and global warming. So our policy is to embrace this change and we do not see a way to respond to the risk.

ACIP pays an annual insurance of EGP 300,000 to protect its assets from accidents and natural disasters. In case of submersion and total loss of capital assets, the insurance should cover ACIP with EGP 101,000,000. Additionally, the Egyptian government spends around EGP 700 million annually to protect the northern Egyptian coast from rising sea levels and floods.

Hydraulic machinery technology is gradually being outdated, making its replacement necessary when the existent ones reach the end of their useful life. ACIP is already planning to embrace the transition to lower emissions technology.

value.text: ACIP supplies its packaging products to numerous local and multinational market leaders within Egypt and internationally. Most of our clients have sustainability goals and targets to meet the new international market standards and global sustainability goals, all including reliance on renewable energy. Additionally, public awareness about sustainability is growing faster than ever, which gives companies relying on renewable energy sources a competitive edge over its competitors relying solely on conventional carbon emitting energy sources. We therefore believe that using a lower emission source of energy such as solar power will increase demand for our products.

ACIP mostly produces PET preforms for multinational clients in the food & beverage industry, most of which include the incorporation of recycled PET in their packaging. In alignment with our clients' targets we have prioritized the incorporation of recycled PET in our raw materials. Besides the reduction of plastic waste ending up in the environment, recycled PET produces far less carbon emissions compared to virgin PET in its production phase and throughout the value chain.

Injection molding machines require a continuous supply of compressed air. Air compressors are one of the major consumers of of electricity at ACIP. By reducing compressed air pressure setting from 40 to 37 bars and fixing some leakage points, immediate energy savings were realized with minimal capital expenditure. Additionally, the performance efficiency of the compressed air system has been improved by installing a wet tank before the dryer and automatic drain valve, saving about 3.5% of the compressed air energy consumption.
It is suggested to install a variable speed drive on the compressor to reduce the energy used in air compression by 8.8%

value.text: Reliance on renewable energy will ensure ACIP's compliance with global sustainability goals and standards, giving us a competitive edge in the industrial packaging industry, which is expected to increase demand for our products, leading to a 15-20 % increase in annual revenue.

Incorporation of recycled materials will ensure ACIP's compliance with global sustainability goals and standards, giving us a competitive edge in the industrial packaging industry, which is expected to increase demand for our products, leading to a 10-15% increase in annual revenue.

Treatment of compressed air leakage avoided compressed air losses leading to excessive energy consumption. Together with reducing the compressed air pressure, the 2 conservation measures now save EGP 90,000 annually.
Wet tanks and automatic drain valves have already been installed and variable speed drives are yet to be installed. When completed, the energy efficiency methods are expected to save a sum of EGP 26,000 annually.

value.text: ACIP is in the process of signing a deal to construct a photovoltaic solar energy plant on our corrugated board roofs to increase reliance on renewable energy. The available and suitable area will allow the installation of a 640 kW Photovoltaic system. When it starts operation, the proposed plant will cover 16% of ACIP's electricity demand from solar energy. ACIP will only need to invest in issuing governmental licenses to construct the plant and to sign a net-metering contract with the electricity distribution company.  A company specialized in solar energy production will make the investment and build and own the plant throughout its lifetime.

ACIP's sustainability department is already thoroughly researching the effect of using recycle PET on our products. Additionally, we are searching for and conducting conversations with reliable manufacturers and suppliers in the Egyptian market as well as international organizations involved in recycling activities to secure a continuous supply of high quality, food grade approved recycled PET in order to achieve our recycling targets without compromising the quality of our products. We are also studying the adjustments and upgrades that have to be made to our existing machinery as well as the optimum operating conditions when using a mixture of recycled PET and virgin PET with the help of international experts in this field. The investment to be made to replace the existing injection nozzles of all ACIP's machinery would be EGP 3,540,000.

Air leakage has already been treated and costed ACIP EGP 5,000.
The combined cost of installing a wet tank, an automatic drain valve and a variable speed drive  is EGP 91,900.

description.ja: コメント

value.text: Besides the expected increase in revenue resulting from higher demand for our products, the photovoltaic system will also result in direct financial savings by reducing our energy bills. The photovoltaic system will be constructed, owned and operated by an independent power producer on our roofs. The generated electricity from the Photovoltaic plant will be purchased under a power purchasing agreement at a reduced price compared to the national grid price. The system will reduce ACIP's electricity costs by 2.5%.

information.en:
•  CDP data users are interested in organizations’ forward-looking strategies and financial decisions that are driven by climate-related future market opportunities, public policy objectives, and corporate responsibilities. This module allows organizations to disclose whether they have acted upon integrating climate-related issues into their business strategy. The module includes questions on scenario analysis and transition planning which are important evolutions in strategic environmental planning. 
  •  Given the importance of forward-looking assessments of climate-related risks and opportunities, scenario analysis is an important and useful tool for an organization to use, both for understanding strategic implications of climate-related risks and opportunities, and for informing stakeholders of how the organization is positioning itself in recognition of these issues. It also can aid investors, lenders, and insurance underwriters in informing their own financial decision making. 
  • Transition planning is also an important evolution of strategic environmental planning, and includes all the relevant changes that need to be made to the company’s business model before the company can adjust to a net-zero future. This is especially relevant for companies operating in high impact sectors. 
  • Climate-related scenario analysis and transition planning disclosure was piloted by CDP in the Assessing Low-Carbon Transition (ACT) initiative in 2016. Further information on conducting and disclosing scenario analysis can be found in the CDP Technical Note on Scenario Analysis. Further information on transition planning can be found in the CDP Climate Transition Plan discussion paper.
  • Responses given in this module should be relevant to the reporting period, even if revisions have been made to your strategy between the reporting period and the time of submission of your CDP response. Where this is the case, you can include more up to date information in C-FI field at the end of the questionnaire. This will not be scored but will be available to investors, banks and customers (in the case of those responding on behalf of Supply Chain Members) that view your response.
  • Note for financial services sector companies: Financial services sector companies are asked to consider how climate-related risks and opportunities will affect business strategy in relation to their lending, financial intermediary, investment and/or insurance underwriting activities, in addition to operational activities.
information.es:
•  Los usuarios de datos de CDP están interesados en las estrategias de las organizaciones con miras al futuro y las decisiones financieras que están impulsadas por las oportunidades de mercado futuro relacionadas con el clima, objetivos de políticas públicas y responsabilidades corporativas. Este módulo permite que las organizaciones divulguen si tomaron medidas para integrar los asuntos relacionados con el clima en su estrategia de negocio. El módulo incluye preguntas sobre análisis de escenarios y planificación de transición que son evoluciones importantes en la planificación ambiental estratégica. 
  •  Dada la importancia de las evaluaciones, con miras al futuro, de riesgos y oportunidades relacionados con el clima, el análisis de escenarios es una herramienta importante y útil que debe utilizar una organización tanto para comprender las implicancias estratégicas de riesgos y oportunidades relacionados con el clima, como para informar a las partes interesadas qué lugar adopta la organización en reconocimiento de estos asuntos. También puede ayudar a los inversionistas, prestamistas y aseguradores a tomar sus propias decisiones financieras. 
  • La planificación de transición también es una evolución importante de la planificación ambiental estratégica e incluye todos los cambios relevantes que deben realizarse al modelo de negocios de la empresa para que pueda cumplir con un futuro de cero emisiones netas de carbono. Esto se aplica especialmente a empresas que operan en sectores de alto impacto. 
  • La divulgación del análisis de escenarios relacionados con el clima y la planificación de transición fue implementada por primera vez por CDP en la iniciativa de Evaluación de transición a niveles más bajos de carbono (Assessing Low-Carbon Transition, ACT) en 2016. Puede encontrar más información sobre la realización y divulgación de análisis de escenarios en la Nota técnica sobre análisis de escenarios de CDP. Puede encontrar más información sobre la planificación de la transición en el documento Plan de transición climática de CDP.
  • Las respuestas que se proporcionan en este módulo deben ser relevantes para el período de reporte de información, incluso si se han realizado modificaciones a su estrategia entre el período de reporte de información y el momento de la presentación de su respuesta a CDP. En estos casos, puede incluir información actualizada en el campo C-FI al final de este cuestionario. Esto no se calificará, pero estará disponible para los inversionistas, bancos y clientes (en el caso de quienes responden a solicitud de miembros del programa Supply Chain) que ven sus respuestas.
  • Nota para las empresas del sector de servicios financieros: Las empresas del sector de servicios financieros deben considerar cómo los riesgos y las oportunidades relacionados con el clima afectarán su estrategia de negocios en relación con sus préstamos, intermediación financiera, inversión y/o emisión de seguros, además de las actividades operativas.
information.ja:
•  CDPのデータ利用者が関心を持っているのは、気候関連の将来における市場機会、公共政策目的、企業責任がもたらした、組織の先見的な戦略および財務決定です。このモジュールによって、組織は気候関連課題を事業戦略に組み込んでいるかどうかについて開示します。モジュールには、戦略的な環境計画の重要な発展形態であるシナリオ分析および移行計画に関する質問が含まれています。 
  •  気候関連リスクおよび機会に対する先見的な評価の重要性を考慮する場合、シナリオ分析は企業が利用できる重要かつ有益なツールです。このツールは、気候関連リスクおよび機会がもつ戦略的意味を理解すること、そして組織がこれらの問題をどう認識しているかをステークホルダーに伝えることの両面で役立ちます。また投資家、融資機関、保険業者にとっても、財務意思決定を下すうえで有益です。 
  • 移行計画も、戦略的な環境計画の重要な発展形態です。ここには、企業がネットゼロの未来に適応する前に企業のビジネスモデルに行う必要がある重要な変化のすべてを含みます。これは特に影響の高いセクターの企業にあてはまります。 
  • 気候関連シナリオ分析と移行計画の開示は、2016年に低炭素経済への移行評価(ACT)イニチアチブでCDPが試験的に実施しました。シナリオ分析の実施と開示について詳しくは、CDPのシナリオ分析に関するテクニカルノートをご覧ください。 移行計画策定に関する詳細については、CDP気候移行計画討議資料をご覧ください。
  • 報告対象期間と貴社のCDP回答の提出時の間に戦略を修正したとしても、このモジュールでの回答は報告対象期間に関連している必要があります。上記に該当する場合は、質問書末尾にあるC-FIの欄にて最新情報を提供することができます。この最新情報は採点対象にはなりませんが、貴社の回答を閲覧する投資家、銀行、顧客(サプライチェーンメンバーに対して回答する場合)に提供されます。
  • 金融サービスセクター向け注記:金融セクターの企業は、気候関連リスクおよび機会が、自社事業活動だけでなく、融資、金融仲介、投資、保険引受に関連した事業戦略に影響を及ぼすかを考慮してください。
information.pt_br:
•  Os usuários dos dados do CDP estão interessados nas estratégias voltadas para o futuro e nas decisões financeiras das organizações que são orientadas por oportunidades de mercado futuras relacionadas ao clima, objetivos de políticas públicas e responsabilidades corporativas. Este módulo permite que as organizações informem se tomaram medidas para integrar as questões climáticas na sua estratégia de negócios. O módulo inclui perguntas sobre análise de cenários e o plano de transição, que são evoluções importantes no planejamento estratégico ambiental. 
  •  Dada a importância das avaliações prospectivas dos riscos e oportunidades climáticos, a análise de cenários é uma ferramenta útil e importante a ser utilizada por uma organização, tanto para compreender as implicações estratégicas dos riscos e oportunidades climáticos, quanto para informar as partes interessadas sobre como a organização se posiciona com relação a essas questões. Também pode ajudar investidores, credores e seguradoras a tomar suas decisões financeiras por conta própria. 
  • O plano de transição também é uma evolução importante do planejamento estratégico ambiental e inclui todas as mudanças relevantes que devem feitas no modelo de negócios da empresa antes que ela possa se adequar a um futuro de zero líquido. Isso é especialmente relevante para empresas que operam em setores de alto impacto. 
  • O CDP realizou um piloto da divulgação do planejamento de transição e da análise de cenários climáticos na iniciativa Assessing Low-Carbon Transition (ACT) em 2016. Maiores informações sobre como conduzir e divulgar uma análise de cenários podem ser encontradas na Nota Técnica sobre a Análise de Cenários do CDP. Maiores informações sobre o planejamento da transição podem ser encontradas no artigo de discussão Plano de Transição Climática do CDP .
  • As respostas dadas neste módulo devem ser relevantes para o período de reporte, mesmo se, entre o período de reporte e o momento do envio da resposta ao CDP, tiverem sido feitas revisões na estratégia. Se for o caso, é possível incluir informações mais atualizadas no campo C-FI, no fim do questionário. Essas informações não serão pontuadas, mas estarão disponíveis para investidores, bancos e clientes (no caso das organizações que estão respondendo em nome de Membros do Programa Supply Chain) que analisarem a resposta.
  • Nota para empresas do setor de serviços financeiros: Pede-se que as empresas do setor financeiro levem em consideração o modo como riscos e oportunidades climáticos afetarão a estratégia de negócios relativa às suas atividades de empréstimo, intermediação financeira, investimentos e/ou subscrição de seguros, além das atividades operacionais.
information.zh_chs:
•  CDP数据使用者希望了解受到未来气候相关市场机遇、公共政策目标和公司责任驱动的公司前瞻性战略和财务决策。本模块让组织得以披露他们是否已经在将气候相关议题纳入其业务战略中采取行动。该模块包括有关情景分析和转型计划的问题，这是战略环境规划的重要进展。 
  •  鉴于气候相关风险和机遇前瞻性评估的重要性，情景分析是一个重要且有用的工具，帮助公司了解气候相关风险和机遇战略影响以及告知利益相关方公司对这些议题的认知情况。该工具还能协助投资者、贷方和保险承保人告知他们自己的财务决策。 
  • 转型计划也是战略环境规划的重要演变，包括公司在能够适应零碳未来之前需要对公司业务模式进行的所有相关变更。这与高影响行业中的公司有着尤为密切的联系。 
  • 气候相关的情景分析和转型计划披露由CDP根据2016年的评估低碳转型 (ACT)（Assessing Low-Carbon Transition）倡议试行。若要获取更多有关情景分析执行和披露的信息，请参见CDP情景分析技术说明。 有关转型计划的更多信息，请查阅CDP气候转型计划讨论文件。
  • 该模块提供的回复应只涉及该报告周期，即使在报告周期和提交CDP回复期间公司战略发生了变更。在这种情况下，您可以在问卷末尾的C-FI域中包含更多最新信息。这并不计分，但可供查看您回复的投资者、银行和客户（在代表供应链合作伙伴回复的情况下）参考。
  • 金融服务业公司须知：除业务活动外，金融服务业公司应考虑气候相关风险和机遇将如何影响其贷款、金融中介、投资和/或保险承保活动的业务战略。

value.text: ACIP understands the importance of developing sustainable products that have minimal impact on the environment as a main pillar of its strategy. This process is still being evaluated as it greatly depends on the readiness of the customer and the end user to accept a change in product specifications, such as leigh weighting, incorporating recycled content or redesigning packaging to make is more recyclable. Additionally, finding reliable suppliers who can assure a consistent supply of high quality materials that would improve our product's carbon footprint and comply with legal standards and customers' specifications inflicts a challenge that is yet to be overcome. A low carbon transition plan has already been developed which would reduce our products' specific carbon emissions significantly. At ACIP, we have started coordinating with stakeholders to develop products that are eco-friendly in every aspect while complying with our customers' specifications and legal standards.

information.en:
• Questions in this module focus on emissions and low-carbon energy targets, additional climate-related targets, net-zero targets, and details on emission reduction initiatives and low-carbon products.
  • Target setting provides direction and structure to environmental strategy. Providing information on quantitative targets and qualitative goals, and progress made against these targets, can demonstrate your organization’s commitment to improving climate-related issues management at a corporate level. This information is relevant to investors’ understanding of how your company is addressing and monitoring progress regarding the risks and opportunities disclosed.
  • Questions on emission reduction initiatives allow CDP data users to understand the organization’s commitment to reducing emissions beyond business-as-usual scenario.
  • Questions on low-carbon products provide valuable information to investors who are seeking to increase their investment in companies providing low-carbon and climate resilient goods and services.
  • Note for agricultural sectors:  The ‘Land management practices’ section includes questions around both adaptation and mitigation mechanisms adopted by companies to address climate change. This information demonstrates that organizations are committed to using practices that help reducing emissions and improve their resilience. Organizations can report up to 20 practices adopted on their land. Those practices that have brought or are expected to bring the largest benefits should be prioritized.
information.es:
• Las preguntas de este módulo se enfocan en las metas de emisión y energía baja en carbono, metas adicionales relacionadas con el clima, metas de cero emisiones netas, detalles sobre iniciativas de reducción de emisiones y productos de bajo nivel de carbono.
  • El establecimiento de metas otorga dirección y estructura a la estrategia medioambiental. Proporcionar información sobre objetivos cualitativos y metas cuantitativas, así como el progreso logrado respecto de estas metas, puede demostrar el compromiso de su organización para mejorar la gestión de los asuntos relacionados con el clima a nivel corporativo. Esta información es relevante para que los inversionistas comprendan cómo su empresa está abordando y monitoreando el progreso respecto de los riesgos y las oportunidades divulgados.
  • Las preguntas sobre las iniciativas de reducción de emisiones permiten a los usuarios de datos de CDP comprender el compromiso de su organización para reducir las emisiones más allá de un escenario habitual.
  • Las preguntas sobre productos de bajo nivel de carbono proporcionan información valiosa a los inversionistas que buscan aumentar su inversión en empresas que proveen productos y servicios resistentes al cambio climático y con bajos niveles de carbono.
  • Nota para el sector agrícola:  La sección ‘Prácticas de gestión de tierras’ contiene preguntas sobre mecanismos tanto de adaptación como de mitigación adoptados por empresas para abordar el cambio climático. Esta información demuestra que las organizaciones están comprometidas a aplicar prácticas que ayudan a reducir las emisiones y mejorar su resiliencia. Las organizaciones pueden informar hasta 20 prácticas adoptadas en su tierra. Se deben priorizar aquellas prácticas que hayan producido o vayan a producir los mayores beneficios.
information.ja:
• このモジュールの質問は、排出と低炭素エネルギー目標、追加の気候関連目標、ネットゼロ目標、排出量削減イニシアチブに関する詳細、および低炭素製品に重点を置いています。
  • 目標設定によって、環境戦略の方向と構造を示します。定量目標と定性目標、またそれらの目標に対する進捗についての情報を提供し、貴社が気候関連問題管理の改善に企業レベルで取り組んでいることを示すことができます。この情報により投資家は、貴社が開示したリスクと機会に関してどのように推進し、進捗をモニタリングしているかを理解できます。
  • 排出削減活動に関する質問により、CDPのデータ利用者は、BAUシナリオを超えた組織の排出削減に対するコミットメントを理解することができます。
  • 低炭素製品に関する質問は、低炭素製品や気候変動に対してレジリエントな(耐性がある)財・サービスを提供する企業への投資を増やしたいと考えている投資家に、貴重な情報を提供します。
  • 農業セクター向け注記: 「土地管理活動」のセクションには、企業が気候変動対策として採用する適応および緩和のメカニズムに関する質問が含まれています。この情報は、組織が排出削減と耐性向上に資する活動を重視していることの証拠となります。組織は自社の所有地で採用された活動を最大20件まで報告できます。なお、特に大きな効果をもたらした活動、もたらすと期待される活動の報告を優先する必要があります。
information.pt_br:
• As perguntas deste módulo têm como foco as metas de emissão e de energia de baixo carbono, metas climáticas adicionais, metas de zero emissões líquidas e detalhes sobre iniciativas de redução das emissões e produtos de baixo carbono.
  • Definir uma meta oferece direção e estrutura para a estratégia ambiental. O fornecimento de informações sobre metas quantitativas e objetivos qualitativos e o progresso alcançado versus as metas, pode demonstrar o comprometimento da sua organização com a melhoria da gestão das questões climáticas em nível corporativo. Estas informações são relevantes para que os investidores compreendam como sua empresa aborda e monitora o progresso com relação aos riscos e oportunidades divulgados.
  • As perguntas sobre as iniciativas de redução das emissões permitem que os usuários dos dados do CDP entendam o comprometimento da organização com a redução das emissões que ultrapasse o cenário usual de negócios.
  • As perguntas sobre produtos com baixos níveis de carbono fornecem informações valiosas aos investidores que estiverem buscando aumentar seus investimentos em empresas que fornecem bens e serviços resilientes ao clima e com baixos níveis de carbono.
  • Nota para os setores agrícolas:  A seção “Práticas de gestão da terra” inclui perguntas sobre os mecanismos de adaptação e de mitigação adotados pelas empresas para enfrentar as mudanças climáticas. Estas informações demonstram que as organizações estão comprometidas com a adoção de práticas que ajudam a reduzir as emissões e a melhorar sua resiliência. As organizações podem reportar até 20 práticas adotadas em suas terras. Devem ser priorizadas as práticas que já tenham trazido, ou que se espera que tragam, os maiores benefícios.
information.zh_chs:
• 本模块的问题重点关注排放和低碳能源目标、其他与气候相关的目标、净零目标、减排行动详情和低碳产品。
  • 目标设置为环境战略提供了方向和结构。提供有关定量目标和定性目标以及目标进展情况的信息有助于展示贵公司在公司层级针对改善气候相关议题管理所做的努力和取得的进展。该信息帮助投资人理解贵公司如何处理和监测所披露风险和机遇的情况。
  • 有关减排行动的问题让CDP数据使用者得以了解公司在现行情景方案之外为减排所做的努力。
  • 有关低碳产品的问题为希望对提供低碳和气候适应型产品和服务的公司增加投资的投资人提供宝贵的信息。
  • 农业说明： “土地管理手段”部分的问题主要围绕公司为解决气候变化所采用的适应和缓解机制。该信息展示公司致力于采用有助于减排和提高适应力的手段。组织可以上报最多20项在公司土地范围内采取的实践。应该优先考虑那些已经或预计将带来最大利益的做法。

value.text:
We have set ourselves targets to reduce scope 1&2 emissions by 25% by 2030 compared to 2020 as the base year.
This target covers all of our scope 1 emissions resulting from fugitive emissions in our facilities and scope 2 emissions resulting from purchased electricity.
This target is approved by the Science Based Targets initiative as consistent with well below 2 degrees.

We have set ourselves targets to reduce scope 1&2 emissions by 40% by 2038 compared to 2020 as the base year.
This target covers all of our scope 1 emissions resulting from fugitive emissions in our facilities and scope 2 emissions resulting from purchased electricity.

value.text:
To achieve the target we have developed a threefold plan to minimize our carbon footprint.
1. Deploying renewable energy: We have dedicated the suitable and available roof space to construct a 640 kW photovoltaic power generation plant. Simulation software has projected that the plant's average annual power output would be 1,141,810 kWh, covering 16% of ACIP's power consumption. We have received several offers from tenderers willing to build, own and operate the plant and have selected our preferred vendor in May 2022. ACIP's management will sign a 25-year power purchasing agreement with the selected vendor as soon as the PPA is finalized and agreed on by both parties. The project is expected to be completed and operational by 2025.
2. Increasing Energy Efficiency: We have identified potential areas of improvement to increase our energy efficiency. Those include replacement of some large hydraulic machinery by modern electric machinery that consume less energy and require much less cooling.
3. Minimizing fugitive emissions: Besides reducing refrigerant use when replacing hydraulic machinery by all electric machinery, we are closely studying the replacement of some refrigerants by more eco-friendly alternatives that are compatible with our machine cooling systems but have a lower global warming potential. We also check our cooling systems on regular basis to identify and repair any leakage to reduce emissions and losses.

We plan to further reduce our scope 1&2 emissions by 15% from 2030 to 2038 compared to the base year 2020, after achieving our 2030 target.
This target is planned to be achieved by replacing smaller hydraulic machines that will be remaining after 2030 over an 8-year period. There is also a plan to replace all electric motors with an energy efficiency classification less than IE3 by more efficient motors with an IE4 or IE5 classification.

value.text: At ACIP we have started a transition to more energy efficient lighting by replacing any conventional light bulbs that need to be replaced by modern LED light bulbs, which cost more but consume much less power. The investment required is determined based on the cost of full replacement by LED lights.

Compressed air losses have been reduced by reducing the compressed air bar setting from 40 to 37 bars, and by regular scheduled maintenance for the compressed air network to prevent leakage. Wet tanks have been installed before the dryers and air automatic valves, saving about 3.5% of the compressed air energy consumption. It is proposed to install a variable speed drive on the compressor to further reduce its energy consumption and achieve maximum compressor energy efficiency.

information.en: • A meaningful and consistent comparison of emissions over time is essential for managing climate-related issues. This module allows companies to provide the base year and base year emissions figure and provide details of the standard, protocol, or methodology used to collect activity data and calculate emissions.
information.es: • Una comparación significativa y sistemática de las emisiones en el transcurso del tiempo es esencial para gestionar los asuntos relacionados con el clima. Este módulo permite que las empresas proporcionen el año base y la cifra de las emisiones del año base y brinden detalles sobre el estándar, el protocolo o la metodología utilizados para recolectar datos de la actividad y calcular las emisiones.
information.ja: • 気候関連課題を管理するためには、経時的な排出量の有意で一貫性のある比較が必須です。このモジュールによって、企業は基準年と基準年排出量、そして活動データを収集して排出量を計算するために使用された基準、プロトコル、方法を具体的に答えることができます。
information.pt_br: • Uma comparação significativa e consistente das emissões ao longo do tempo é essencial para a gestão dos problemas climáticos. Este módulo permite que as empresas indiquem o ano-base e o valor das emissões no ano-base e forneçam detalhes da norma, do protocolo ou da metodologia utilizados para coletar os dados das atividades e calcular as emissões.
information.zh_chs: • 对于管理气候相关问题，按照时间对排放进行有意义的一致性对比是必不可少的。本模块让公司得以提供基准年和基准年排放数据，并详细说明收集活动数据和计算排放量所采用的标准、协议或方法学。

options.option_label: The Greenhouse Gas Protocol: A Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard (Revised Edition)
The Greenhouse Gas Protocol: Scope 2 Guidance

information.en:
• Reporting emissions is best practice and a prerequisite to understanding and reducing negative environmental impacts. 
  • This module examines emissions data details and is aligned with TCFD Metrics & Targets recommended disclosure b) Disclose Scope 1, Scope 2, and, if appropriate, Scope 3 greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, and the related risks. 
  •  The GHG Protocol is developing new Land Sector and Removals Guidance. This new guidance is currently in the pilot testing and review phase, and will be finalized and published in 2023. Companies responding to the CDP 2023 climate change questionnaire should report in accordance with existing GHG Protocol corporate standards, and not use the draft land sector and removals guidance for CDP reporting in 2023, as it is still under development.
information.es:
• Informar las emisiones es una práctica recomendada y un prerrequisito para entender y reducir el impacto negativo en el medio ambiente. 
  • Este módulo examina los detalles de los datos de emisiones y está alineado con la divulgación de Métricas y metas recomendada por el TCFD b) Divulgar las emisiones de gases de efecto invernadero (GEI) de alcance 1, alcance 2 y, en caso de corresponder, alcance 3 y los riesgos relacionados. 
  •  El GHG Protocol está desarrollando una nueva Guía sobre el sector de la tierra y remociones. Actualmente, esta nueva guía está en fase de prueba y revisión, y se completará y publicará en 2023. Las empresas que respondan el cuestionario de Cambio Climático 2023 de CDP deben reportar la información en consonancia con los estándares corporativos existentes del GHG Protocol y no deben usar el borrador de la guía sobre el sector de la tierra y remociones para el reporte a CDP en 2023, ya que todavía está en desarrollo.
information.ja:
• 排出量を報告することは、悪い環境影響を理解し、それを低減させるための最良実施例であり、かつ前提条件です。 
  • 排出量データを詳細に取り上げる本モジュールは、TCFD「指標と目標」が提言する開示である、b )スコープ1、スコープ2、および該当する場合はスコープ3の温室効果ガス排出量、および関連リスクの開示と整合しています。 
  •  GHGプロトコルは新しい[⼟地セクター・炭素除去に関するガイダンス]の策定を進めています。この新たなガイダンスは現在、パイロットテストおよびレビューが行われており、2023年に完成・公開される予定です。CDP気候変動質問書2023に回答する企業は、既存のGHGプロトコルの企業基準に従って報告する必要があります。[土地セクター・炭素除去に関するガイダンス]草案はまだ作成中であるため、CDPの回答には使用しないでください。
information.pt_br:
• A divulgação das emissões é uma boa prática e um pré-requisito para se compreenderem e se reduzirem os impactos ambientais negativos. 
  • Este módulo examina os detalhes dos dados de emissão e está alinhado com o reporte recomendada para Métricas e Metas da TCFD : b) Divulgue as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE) de Escopo 1, Escopo 2 e, se for o caso, Escopo 3, e os riscos relacionados. 
  •  O GHG Protocol está desenvolvendo um novo Guia para o setor de terras e remoções. Este novo guia está na fase de teste piloto e revisão e será finalizado e publicado em 2023. As empresas que respondem ao questionário de mudanças climáticas do CDP de 2023 devem reportar em conformidade com as normas corporativas do GHG Protocol existentes e não devem utilizar o guia do setor de terras e remoções em versão preliminar para o reporte ao CDP em 2023, por ainda estar em desenvolvimento.
information.zh_chs:
• 报告排放是认识和减少负面环境影响的最佳实践和先决条件。 
  • 该模块检查排放数据，且符合TCFD指标和目标建议披露 b）披露范围一、范围二，以及范围三（如适用）的温室气体（GHG）排放和相关风险。 
  •  GHG Protocol（温室气体协议）正在制定新的土地部门和清除指南。这份新指南目前正处于试点测试和审查阶段，将于2023年定稿并发布。对CDP 2023年气候变化问卷做出答复的公司应根据现有的GHG Protocol（温室气体协议）公司标准进行报告，而不要使用CDP 2023年报告的土地部门和清除指南草案，因为该草案仍在制定中。

value.text:
During 2021, ACIP had a major maintenance for its chillers, which required the replacement of a huge amount of refrigerant resulting in the significant increase in Scope 1 emissions and therefore the combined scope 1&2 emissions.
But in 2022, ACIP only had a regular & periodical maintenance for its chillers resulting in the decrease of scope 1. At this period also we got a new building so our scope 2 is higher than the last year.

information.en:
• This module enables respondents to break down Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by country/area, business division, facility, sector and subsidiary.
  • By breaking down emissions by country/area or region, this data can be made available to regions, states and sub-national bodies to help guide the development of emissions-related legislation. 
  • Breaking down emissions by business division, facility and activity  or subsidiary grants data users and investors transparency into the sources of a company's Scope 1 and 2 emissions and allows tracking the performance of divisions, individual facilities or subsidiaries  over time.
  • The module also requests data on emissions other than carbon dioxide. These gases are often only reported in CO2-equivalents (CO2e), and so their contribution to overall emissions is sometimes masked.
information.es:
• Este módulo permite desglosar las emisiones de alcance 1 y alcance 2 por país/área, división de la empresa, instalación, sector y subsidiaria.
  • Al desglosar los valores de las emisiones por país/área o región, los datos pueden quedar disponibles para las regiones, los estados y los organismos provinciales y locales, con el objetivo de ser utilizados en el desarrollo de legislación relacionada con las emisiones. 
  • Desglosar las emisiones por división de la empresa, instalación y actividad o subsidiaria ofrece a los usuarios de datos e inversionistas transparencia sobre las fuentes de emisiones de alcance 1 y alcance 2 de una empresa y permite hacer un seguimiento del desempeño de determinadas divisiones, instalaciones particulares o subsidiarias en el transcurso del tiempo.
  • Este módulo también requiere datos sobre emisiones además del dióxido de carbono. Debido a que estos gases a menudo se reportan solo como equivalentes de CO2 (CO2e), su contribución a las emisiones globales a veces queda enmascarada.
information.ja:
• 本モジュールでは、スコープ1およびスコープ2排出量を、国/地域、事業部門、施設、活動セクター、子会社別に分類して回答いただけます。
  • 排出量を国/地域/広域別に分類することで、広域、国・州、地域がこのデータを入手できるようにして、排出関連法の作成を導くのに役立てることができます。 
  • 排出量を事業部門、施設、活動、子会社別に分類することで、企業のスコープ1および2排出源についての透明性をデータ利用者と投資家に提供し、部門や個別の施設または子会社の業績を経時的に追跡することも可能になります。
  • 本モジュールでは、二酸化炭素以外のGHG排出についても回答を要請しています。これらのガスはCO2換算値(CO2e)のみで報告されことが多く、そのため排出量全体に占める割合が不明瞭になることがあります。
information.pt_br:
• Este módulo permite que os participantes discriminem as emissões de Escopo 1 e de Escopo 2 por país/área, divisão de negócios, instalação, setor e subsidiária.
  • Ao discriminar as emissões por país/área ou região, esses dados poderão ser disponibilizados para entidades regionais, estaduais e subnacionais, para ajudar a orientar o desenvolvimento de uma legislação relacionada às emissões. 
  • A discriminação das emissões por divisão de negócios, instalação e atividade ou subsidiária oferece transparência aos usuários dos dados e aos investidores com relação às fontes das emissões de Escopo 1 e 2 de uma empresa e permite monitorar o desempenho de divisões, instalações individuais ou subsidiárias ao longo do tempo.
  • O módulo também exige dados sobre outras emissões além do dióxido de carbono. Estes gases muitas vezes só são reportados em CO2-equivalente (CO2e), assim, às vezes, sua contribuição para as emissões totais é mascarada.
information.zh_chs:
• 该模块要求回复者按照国家/地区、业务分支、设施、行业和子公司细分范围一和范围二的排放。
  • 通过将排放量细分到国家/地区或区域层面，可向地区、国家和次国家机构提供信息和数据，以协助指导与排放相关法规的制定。 
  • 按照业务分支、工厂、活动或子公司细分排放量，让数据使用者和投资者能够清晰透明地了解到公司范围一和二的排放源，并得以按照时间追踪公司分支机构、工厂或子公司的表现。
  • 该模块也要求提供除二氧化碳之外的其他排放数据。因为这些气体通常只报告为CO2当量（CO2e），因此它们对总排放的贡献有时会被掩盖。

information.en:
• Energy related activities represent, for many sectors, the most significant GHG emission sources. This module provides transparency on the consumption and generation of energy by organizations. 
  • Accurate emissions accounting depends on a comprehensive account of energy. It is expected that organizations have already collected the necessary energy data for the disclosure of emissions in previous modules. Unless otherwise stated in the question-specific guidance, energy generation data requested in this module is in alignment with Scope 1 emissions sources i.e. from generating units owned or controlled by the organization. The requested data on purchased or acquired energy is in alignment with Scope 2 emissions reporting.
information.es:
• Para muchos sectores, las actividades relacionadas con la energía representan la fuente más significativa de emisiones de GEI. Este módulo ofrece transparencia sobre el consumo y la generación de energía por parte de las organizaciones. 
  • La divulgación precisa de las emisiones depende de una consideración integral de la energía. Las organizaciones deben ya haber recolectado los datos de energía necesarios para la divulgación de emisiones en los módulos anteriores. A menos que se indique lo contrario en la orientación específica para cada pregunta, los datos sobre la generación de energía solicitados en este módulo coinciden con las fuentes de emisiones de alcance 1, es decir son provenientes de unidades generadoras que son propiedad de la organización o están controladas por ella. Los datos solicitados sobre la energía comprada o adquirida coinciden con las emisiones de alcance 2.
information.ja:
• 多くのセクターにおいて、エネルギー関連活動は最大の温室効果ガス排出源です。このモジュールによって、組織によるエネルギーの消費と生成に関する透明性を提供します。 
  • 正確な排出量の算定には、包括的なエネルギーについての算定が必須です。すでにこの前のモジュールで排出量の開示に必要なエネルギーデータは集まっていると思われます。質問固有のガイダンスで特に明記しない限り、このモジュールで要請されるエネルギー生成データは、スコープ1排出源、すなわち、組織によって所有または管理される生成装置によるデータに一致します。購入または取得したエネルギーに関して要請されたデータは、スコープ2排出量報告と一致します。
information.pt_br:
• As atividades relacionadas à energia representam, para muitos setores, as fontes mais significativas de emissões de GEE. Este módulo fornece transparência sobre o consumo e a geração de energia pelas organizações. 
  • Uma contabilização precisa das emissões depende de uma contabilização abrangente da energia. Espera-se que as organizações já tenham coletado os dados energéticos necessários para o reporte das emissões nos módulos precedentes. Salvo se definido em contrário na orientação específica da pergunta, os dados de geração de energia solicitados neste módulo estão em alinhamento com as fontes de emissões de Escopo 1, ou seja, provenientes de unidades de geração de posse ou sob o controle de uma organização. Os dados solicitados sobre a energia comprada ou adquirida estão em alinhamento com o reporte das emissões de Escopo 2.
information.zh_chs:
• 在许多行业，能源相关活动是最主要的GHG排放源。该模块为各组织的能源消耗量和生成量提供透明度。 
  • 准确的排放量核算取决于能源的全面计算。预计公司已经在之前的模块中为披露排放量收集到必须的能源数据。除非问题特定指南中另有说明，否则该模块中要求的能源生产数据应与范围一排放源一致，即来自组织自有或控制的发电机组。所要求的能源采购或获取数据与范围二排放中所上报的信息一致。

information.en:
• This module requests reporting organizations to present relevant climate-related metrics that may indirectly or directly impact their emissions or energy use.
  • This module includes one general question on additional climate-related metrics and a number of sector-specific questions on metrics such as production outputs, low-carbon technology implementation, transfers & sequestration of CO2 emissions and low-carbon investments.
information.es:
• Este módulo requiere que las organizaciones presenten las métricas relacionadas con el clima que pueden afectar en forma directa o indirecta sus emisiones o uso de energía.
  • Este módulo incluye una pregunta general sobre métricas adicionales relacionadas con el clima y una serie de preguntas sectoriales sobre métricas, tales como resultados de producción, implementación de tecnología de bajo nivel de carbono, transferencias y secuestro de emisiones de CO2 e inversiones con bajos niveles de carbono.
information.ja:
• このモジュールでは、報告組織の排出量またはエネルギー使用量に間接的または直接的に影響を及ぼす可能性がある関連気候関連指標を示すことを求めます。
  • 本モジュールには、気候関連の追加指標に関する1つの一般的質問のほか、生産高、低炭素技術の導入、CO2排出の移転および隔離、低炭素投資等の指標に関するセクター別の多数の質問が含まれています。
information.pt_br:
• Este módulo pede que as organizações reportantes apresentem métricas climáticas relevantes que possam causar um impacto, direto ou indireto, em suas emissões ou uso de energia.
  • Este módulo inclui uma pergunta geral sobre as métricas adicionais relacionadas ao clima e uma série de perguntas específicas para o seu setor, tais como resultados da produção, implementação de tecnologias de baixo carbono, transferências e sequestro das emissões de CO2 e investimentos de baixos níveis de carbono.
information.zh_chs:
• 该模块要求公司提供可能会间接或直接影响排放或能源使用的气候相关指标。

information.es:
• La verificación y garantía son una buena práctica en la divulgación de información ambiental que garantiza la calidad de los datos y procesos divulgados.
  • Este módulo requiere detalles de los estados de verificación que se aplican a las emisiones de alcances 1, 2 y 3, así como la verificación de otra información relacionada con el clima divulgada a CDP.

  • 本モジュールでは、組織が報告したスコープ1、2、3排出量についての検証状況と、CDP開示で報告したその他の気候関連情報の検証の詳細について、お答えいただきます。
information.pt_br:
• A verificação e a garantia são boas práticas de reporte ambiental, pois asseguram a qualidade dos dados e dos processos reportados.
  • Este módulo pede detalhes sobre o estado de verificação aplicável às emissões de Escopo 1, 2 e 3 reportadas pela organização, assim como sobre a verificação de outras informações relacionadas ao clima reportadas no reporte para o CDP.
information.zh_chs:

title.ja: C11.カーボン プライシング

information.en:
• Carbon pricing has emerged as a key policy mechanism to drive greenhouse gas emissions reductions and mitigate the dangerous impacts of climate change. As the number of jurisdictions with carbon pricing policies increases, CDP data users are interested in understanding how companies are affected by these schemes. 
  • This module examines details on the operations or activities regulated by carbon pricing systems, carbon credits and internal prices on carbon. 
  • For further guidance on reporting to the questions in this module see CDP’s Technical Note Carbon Pricing: CDP Disclosure Best Practice.
information.es:
• El precio de carbono se ha posicionado como un mecanismo de política clave para impulsar la reducción de emisiones de gases efecto invernadero y mitigar los peligrosos impactos del cambio climático. Como la cantidad de jurisdicciones que cuentan con políticas de fijación de precios de carbono ha aumentado, los usuarios de datos de CDP tienen interés en comprender cómo las empresas se ven afectadas por estos planes. 
  • Este módulo examina los detalles de las operaciones o actividades reguladas por los sistemas de fijación de precio de carbono, los créditos de carbono y los precios internos de carbono. 
  • Para obtener más información sobre cómo responder las preguntas de este módulo, consulte la Nota técnica de CDP Precio del carbono: Mejores prácticas de divulgación de CDP.
information.ja:
• カーボンプライシング(炭素排出への価格付け)は、温室効果ガス排出削減を促し、気候変動の危険な影響を緩和するための重要な政策メカニズムとして登場しました。カーボンプライシング政策を採用した管轄区域の数は増加しているため、CDPデータ利用者は、企業がこれらの制度からどのように影響を受けているかに関心をもっています。 
  • 本モジュールでは、カーボンプライシング制度、カーボンクレジット、社内カーボンプライシングのもとでの操業または活動について、詳細にお答えいただきます。 
  • 本モジュールの質問への回答に関する詳しいガイダンスについては、CDPのテクニカルノートカーボンプライシング:CDP開示のベストプラクティスをご覧ください。
information.pt_br:
• A precificação do carbono vem surgindo como um mecanismo-chave das políticas para motivar reduções nas emissões de gases do efeito estufa e mitigar os impactos perigosos das mudanças climáticas. Com o aumento no número de jurisdições com políticas de precificação do carbono, os usuários dos dados do CDP estão interessados em compreender como as empresas são afetadas por estes esquemas. 
  • Este módulo examina em detalhes as operações ou as atividades reguladas pelos sistemas de precificação do carbono, os créditos de carbono e os preços internos do carbono. 
  • Para mais orientações sobre como reportar as perguntas deste módulo, consulte a Nota Técnica do CDP Precificação do Carbono: Melhores Práticas de Reporte do CDP.
information.zh_chs:
• 碳定价是驱动温室气体减排，缓解气候变化危险影响的关键政策机制。由于拥有碳定价政策的辖区数量增加，CDP的数据使用者希望了解公司是如何受到这些计划的影响。 
  • 该模块检查碳定价系统规定的运营或活动、碳信用额度和内部碳价的详细信息。 
  • 若要获取更多关于本模块问题上报指南的信息，请参见CDP的技术说明碳定价：CDP披露最佳实践。

information.en:
• In order to truly reduce global emissions, companies must engage with their value chain on climate-related issues. Questions in this module examine how organizations are working with their suppliers, customers and other partners. 
  • This module provides data users with insight into the different types of activities in which organizations engage to influence public policy on climate-related issues. 
  • The module also investigates whether organizations integrate non-financial metrics and data into mainstream financial reports which is aligned with the TCFD’s primary aim to have climate-related information disclosed in financial filings.
information.es:
• Para reducir verdaderamente las emisiones globales, las empresas deben involucrarse con su cadena de valor en asuntos climáticos. Las preguntas en este módulo examinan cómo las organizaciones están trabajando con sus proveedores, clientes y otros socios. 
  • Este módulo proporciona a los usuarios de datos información sobre diferentes tipos de actividades en las que las organizaciones intentan afectar la política púbica sobre asuntos relacionados con el clima. 
  • El módulo también investiga si las organizaciones integran métricas y datos no financieros dentro de informes financieros convencionales, lo cual responde al objetivo principal de TCFD de divulgar información relacionada con el clima en presentaciones financieras.
information.ja:
• 全体的な排出量を本当な削減するには、企業は気候関連問題に関してバリューチェーンと協働する必要があります。本モジュールでは、組織がサプライヤー、顧客、その他のパートナー組織とどのようにエンゲージメントしているかをお答えいただきます。 
  • 本モジュールによりデータ利用者は、組織が気候関連課題に関する公共政策に対して影響力を行使するために行っているさまざまな種類の活動について理解することができます。 
  • 本モジュールではまた、組織が非財務指標やデータをメインストリームの財務報告書(法定開示)に組み込んでいるかを回答します。これは、気候関連情報を財務報告書に掲載するというTCFDの主な目的ことに沿ったものです。
information.pt_br:
• Para realmente reduzir o total de emissões, as empresas devem estar engajadas com sua cadeia de valor nas questões climáticas. As perguntas deste módulo examinam como as organizações trabalham com seus fornecedores, clientes e outros parceiros. 
  • Este módulo fornece aos usuários dos dados uma percepção dos diferentes tipos de atividades nas quais as organizações se envolvem para influenciar as políticas públicas sobre as questões relacionadas ao clima. 
  • O módulo também investiga se as organizações integram dados e métricas não financeiros nos relatórios financeiros tradicionais alinhados com o objetivo principal da TCFD para que as informações relacionadas ao clima estejam divulgadas nos arquivos financeiros.
information.zh_chs:
• 为了真正减少全球排放，公司必须在其价值链中纳入气候相关问题。该模块的问题检查公司与其供应商、客户和其他合作伙伴的合作方式。 
  • 该模块让数据使用者深入了解公司参与的，能够影响气候相关议题公共政策的不同类型活动。 
  • 该模块还调查公司是否将非财务指标和数据整合进财务报告中，这符合TCFD将气候相关信息披露在财务文件中的主要目标。

we are one of the very few Egyptian companies to have committed to the science-based targets (SBT) initiative and the first company in Egypt to have an approved target. 
Worldwide, we are among 2,466 companies committing to the initiative and of only 1,155 companies with an approved target.
In October 2022, we took part in the “Egypt Solar Energy Declaration”, and we are one of the founding signatories of this declaration which was initiated by the UN Global Compact in Egypt.

information.en:
• Disclosure on actions to preserve or improve biodiversity will help organizations to evaluate the relevancy and efficacy of their commitments and consider the biodiversity-related risks and impacts of their business practices.
  • The data will help with the understanding of the interdependence between biodiversity and business resilience. Demand is increasing for biodiversity-related data that will enable financial institutions to develop investment strategies, and to engage effectively with companies to address the loss of forests and biodiversity that is exposing them to risk throughout their value chains.
  • This module takes a staged, circular approach, aligned with the International Union for the Conservation of Nature (IUCN’s) guidelines for the planning and monitoring biodiversity performance by companies:
    • Develop a set of linked corporate level biodiversity performance indicators
    • Implement systems to use the indicators and the data they produce
    • Evaluate progress with a periodic review of priorities, ambitions and indicators.
  • In addition, companies will report on their approach to the governance of biodiversity–related issues.
  • The questions in this module were influenced by the 4 stage structure as outlined in the IUCN: Guidelines for planning and monitoring corporate biodiversity performance.
information.es:
• El reporte de las acciones para preservar o mejorar la biodiversidad ayudarán a las organizaciones a evaluar la relevancia y eficacia de sus compromisos, y a considerar los riesgos e impactos relacionados con la biodiversidad que tienen sus prácticas comerciales.
  • Los datos ayudarán a comprender la interdependencia ente la biodiversidad y la resiliencia empresarial. Cada vez aumenta más la demanda de datos relacionados con la biodiversidad que les permitirán a las instituciones financieras desarrollar estrategias de inversión y vincularse efectivamente con las empresas para abordar la pérdida de bosques y la biodiversidad que los expone a riesgos en sus cadenas de valor.
  • Este módulo adopta un enfoque circular, dividido en etapas y alineado con las pautas de la Unión Internacional para la Conservación de la Naturaleza (UICN) para la planificación y el monitoreo del desempeño en materia de biodiversidad por parte de las empresas:
    • Desarrollar un conjunto de indicadores de desempeño en materia de biodiversidad, que estén vinculados entre sí y al nivel corporativo.
    • Implementar sistemas para usar los indicadores y los datos que ofrecen.
    • Evaluar el progreso con una revisión periódica de las prioridades, las ambiciones y los indicadores.
  • Además, las empresas informarán su enfoque para la gobernanza de los asuntos relacionados con la biodiversidad.
  • Las preguntas en este módulo estuvieron influenciadas por la estructura de 4 etapas descrita en el documento UICN: Pautas para la planificación y el monitoreo del desempeño corporativo en materia de biodiversidad.
information.ja:
• 生物多様性の保全や改善に向けた行動に関する情報開示は、組織がそのコミットメントの関連性と有効性を評価し、事業活動の生物多様性関連リスクと影響を検討するのに役立ちます。
  • データは、生物多様性とビジネス耐性の間の相互依存の理解に役立ちます。金融機関が投資戦略を策定し、バリューチェーン全体でリスクに曝されている森林と生物多様性の喪失に対処するために企業と効果的に協働することを可能にする生物多様性関連データに対する需要が高まっています。
  • このモジュールでは、生物多様性実績の企業別計画策定およびモニタリングに関する国際自然保護連合(IUCN)のガイドラインに整合した段階的な循環的アプローチを採用します:
    • 一連の企業レベルの生物多様性実績指標を作成
    • 指標とそれらが作り出すデータを使用するシステムの導入
    • 優先事項、意欲、および指標を定期的に見直し、進捗を評価。
  • さらに、生物多様性関連問題のガバナンスのための手法に関しても企業は報告します。
  • このモジュールの質問は、IUCN:企業の生物多様性のパフォーマンスを計画および監視するためのガイドラインで説明する4段階構造の影響を受けています。
information.pt_br:
• O reporte de ações para a preservação ou a melhoria da biodiversidade ajudará as organizações a avaliar a relevância e a eficiência dos seus compromissos e a levar em consideração os riscos e os impactos das suas práticas de negócios para a biodiversidade.
  • Os dados ajudarão a compreender a interdependência entre a biodiversidade e a resiliência empresarial. Há um aumento na demanda por dados relacionados à biodiversidade que permitirão que as instituições financeiras desenvolvam estratégias de investimento, e se engajem com eficiência com as empresas para enfrentar a perda das florestas e da biodiversidade que as está expondo a riscos ao longo da sua cadeia de valor.
  • Este módulo adota uma abordagem circular por estágios, alinhada com as diretrizes da União Internacional para a Conservação da Natureza (IUCN) para o planejamento e o monitoramento do desempenho em biodiversidade das empresas:
    • Desenvolver um conjunto de indicadores vinculados de desempenho em biodiversidade de nível corporativo
    • Implementar sistemas para o uso dos indicadores e os dados que eles produzem
    • Avaliar o progresso com uma análise periódica das prioridades, das ambições e dos indicadores.
  • Além disso, as empresas reportarão sua abordagem da governança de questões relacionadas à biodiversidade.
  • As perguntas deste módulo foram influenciadas pela estrutura em quatro estágios, conforme descrito em IUCN: Orientações para planejamento e monitoramento do desempenho empresarial na biodiversidade.
information.zh_chs:
• 披露保护或改善生物多样性的行动将有助于各组织评估其承诺的相关性和有效性，并考虑其商业实践的生物多样性相关风险和影响。
  • 这些数据将有助于理解生物多样性和商业韧性之间的相互依存关系。对生物多样性相关数据需求日益增加，这些数据将帮助金融机构制定投资战略，并与企业开展有效合作，从而解决企业在价值链中面临的森林和生物多样性减少的风险问题。
  • 本模块采用分阶段、循环的方法，与国际自然保护联盟（IUCN）关于公司规划和监测生物多样性成果的指南保持一致：
    • 制定一套相关的企业级生物多样性绩效指标
    • 开发系统以使用指标及其产生的数据
    • 通过定期审查优先事项、目标和指标来评估进展情况。
  • 此外，公司将报告其对生物多样性相关问题的治理方法。
  • 本模块中的问题受到IUCN中概述的四阶段结构的影响：规划和监测企业生物多样性成果的指南。
